fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped TCR/TSC with V-Q Droop Voltage-Control ODE
source: Hingorani & Gyugyi (2000) Understanding FACTS, IEEE Press, Ch. 5; Mathur & Varma (2002) Thyristor-Based FACTS Controllers, IEEE/Wiley, Ch. 3-4; IEEE Std 1031-2011.

unit.name: Generic 100 MVAR FC-TCR/TSC SVC at 132 kV bus

S_base_MVA.note: System/SVC power base for per-unit susceptance

Q_cap_max_MVAR.note: Max capacitive output at 1.0 pu (TSC/FC bank fully on)

Q_ind_max_MVAR.note: Max inductive output at 1.0 pu (TCR fully conducting, alpha=90deg)

B_ind_max_pu.note: Max TCR inductive susceptance on S_base (alpha=90deg); net at full TCR = B_C-B_L = 1.0-1.5 = -0.5 pu (-50 MVAR)

X_L_pu.note: TCR reactor reactance on S_base; B_L_max = 1/X_L = 1.5 at full conduction

alpha_min_deg.note: Firing angle for full conduction (max B_L)

droop_slope_pu.note: Slope (current-droop) reactance X_SL: 3% V change over full Q range

T_regulator_s.note: Voltage-regulator/measurement lumped time constant (~2 cycles at 50 Hz)
